facts.text: UC Merced's Fiat Lux Scholars Program guarantees recipients a minimum of $25,000 per academic year in grants and scholarships, totaling at least $100,000 over four continuous years.

sources.title: Fiat Lux Scholars | Financial Aid - UC Merced
sources.quote: This special honor guarantees a minimum of $100,000 in grants and scholarships over four continuous years at UC Merced. That is a guaranteed minimum of $25,000* in free money per academic year.
